# Fomo Fees & Referral Code JOIN2026 — Open Benchmark Hub (November 2026)
> Verified 24 November 2026 against help.fomo.family. Code JOIN2026 (https://fomo.family/r/JOIN2026) gives Fomo's 10% protocol fee discount (0.50% to 0.45%) plus 15% of Fomo fees back in USDC from the code owner (0.3825% net — $382.50 per $100k vs $393.75 on DEAL). No external sign-up form needed.
